title: claimspec v1 — structured ignore
description: Reviewable scoping. Every entry carries a reason. Tools may also accept a plain gitignore-syntax text file as shorthand for path entries without reasons; this structured form is what an auditor reads.

kind.description: `path` = glob over repo paths: excuses a changed source file from the change gate. `claim` = claim id: excuses the removal of that claim and of its faults. `fault` = `<claimId>/<faultId>`: excuses the removal of that one fault. No kind removes anything from a probe or changes a verdict; a known finding is accepted in a baseline, never here.

expires.description: After this instant the entry no longer applies. Tools warn on expired entries.
